archetypes.name: dyn-arch-ack
archetypes.rationale: Acknowledgment requiredness is the highest-risk dispatcher contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 2 architectural acknowledgment path. Verify the launch-time snapshot, fallback predicate, and direct bail ordering cannot route a missing acknowledgment through recoverable manifest fallback. Pay special attention to complete and needs_qa manifests and malformed or absent snapshots. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
